english: On the floor beneath the shelf you find a pile of broken porcelain.
Damn. It's like a clump, he says, and coughs a little.
The heat must have been extremely intense at this spot to cause such an effect.
Old Master had cup like this!
E-I'll stop looking at the cups, I think.
This old master of yours sure is a strange character.
Grabbing the edge of a cup reveals how stuck it is.
You can't move it an inch.
They've been deformed by the fire.
The heat must've been thousands of degrees.
It would only break. No use.
